title: The BGK model with in-flow boundary condition: forward and inverse problems
summary: We study the Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) equation in a bounded domain with in-flow boundary condition. The BGK model is a simple relaxation of the Boltzmann equation through replacing the quadratic nonlinearity by the so-called local Maxwellian, which consists of the density, the velocity, and the temperature. The aim of this paper is twofold. First, we establish the Dirichlet boundary value problem for the BGK equation by showing a local existence result in the weighted $L^\infty$ norm if the initial data and boundary condition are close to the global Maxwellian.
